text:
nora: Heads-up — Customer BetaLabs reported a spike on their March 18 invoice. Looks like embed bill higher by ~450k tokens. No product changes on their side.
sam: Can you drop a sample request_id? I'll query the embedding_events table.
nora: Pasted in ticket: rBETA_8812, time ~2027-03-18T02:12:00Z.
diego: Running quick query now. I'm seeing multiple events with same request_id but different vector_hashes where hashes are 16-char truncated values. Snippet: ```sql
SELECT request_id, vector_hash, count(*)
FROM embedding_events
WHERE request_id = 'rBETA_8812'
GROUP BY request_id, vector_hash;
```
-- returns two rows for same request_id with different truncated hashes
billing-bot: Alert: dedupe-failure-rate for customer=BETA over last 6h = 0.9% (>0.5% threshold).
priya: If hashes are truncated at 16 chars at the SDK, our vector_hash dedupe will miss collisions. Do we also have idempotency keys recorded?
sam: The ingest record shows null idempotency_key for those events. SDK v3.4 removed idempotency header for batch endpoints — customer is using that version per user-agent.
nora: So reason: no idempotency + truncated vector_hash => duplicates counted.
diego: Proposed remediation: 1) run a backfill to merge duplicates by (customer, request_id) where event_time between '2027-03-18 00:00' and '2027-03-18 06:00'; 2) compute token delta; 3) create ledger credit entries.
sam: I can craft the dedupe query. For an estimate: ```sql
WITH dups AS (
 SELECT customer_id, request_id, count(*) cnt, sum(tokens) toks
 FROM embedding_events
 WHERE event_time BETWEEN '2027-03-18'::date AND '2027-03-18'::date + interval '1 day'
 GROUP BY customer_id, request_id
 HAVING count(*) > 1
)
SELECT sum((cnt - 1) * (toks / cnt)) as duplicate_tokens FROM dups;
```
-- quick run returns ~453,200 dup tokens for BetaLabs
priya: Finance, we'll need the dollar amount and memo for the ledger. Current rate is $0.00012/token for embeddings on Beta plan.
nora: That'd be ~ $54.38. Can finance approve one-off credit? Also need approval to notify customer and run backfill.
diego: Technical mitigation: change ingest pipeline to prefer full vector_hash (store 64-char hash) and fall back to idempotency_key; also add ingestion rule to log SDK user-agent and vector hash length.
sam: I deployed a short-term query-level guard: if vector_hash length <= 20 and idempotency_key is null, mark event for manual review and do not bill until dry-run complete. Canary shows it catches the flagged set.
priya: OK finance — can you post the exact ledger adjustment lines? We need: customer_id=BETA, amount=$-54.38, memo="dedupe: vector_hash truncation (Mar 18)".
nora: Also please add in the customer note that we found dedupe issue due to SDK truncation and we've applied a credit; ask them to upgrade SDK v3.5 that sends full hash.
billing-bot: Backfill task created: BF-2027-3305, dry-run completed. Potential ledger impact: -$54.38. Requires manual approve.
priya: Approved. Please include request_ids CSV and the delta breakdown per invoice line.
diego: Uploaded CSV to ticket. Backfill job BF-2027-3305 scheduled to run in 30 min.
sam: After backfill completes, we should add a metric to billing dashboards: `fraction_truncated_hash_events` and set an alert at 0.2%.
nora: Thanks team. Priya + Billing, please notify BetaLabs after adjustments. Also tag SDK team so they can push an auto-upgrade notice.
priya: I'll draft the customer email. Quick note: mark the credit as one-time goodwill; don't change pricing.
nora: Closing the loop once BF-2027-3305 finishes. Great catch everyone.
